rules.name: NY FVG continuation after liquidity sweep
entry_conditions: Higher-timeframe bias is aligned with the intended trade direction
A liquidity sweep occurs against the intended direction and is reclaimed by a candle-body close
A fair value gap exists in the intended direction and price retraces into the gap
Setup forms during the New York session (or London/New York overlap)
No active high-impact CPI/NFP/FOMC blackout for the symbol currency
invalidation_conditions: Candle-body close beyond the FVG extreme against the trade
Candle-body close beyond the liquidity-sweep extreme against the trade
Higher-timeframe bias flips against the trade before entry
exit_conditions: Primary target at 2R from entry using the planned stop distance
Optional partial at opposing intraday liquidity if reached first
Exit if invalidation prints after entry
risk_controls: Maximum planned risk 1% of account per trade
Maximum one new trade per New York session day
No new trades during verified high-impact event blackout
execution_enabled remains false until separate demo validation is complete

sources.title: ICT Market Structure Notes
sources.snippet: A bullish fair value gap forms after bullish displacement. Entry is considered on the retracement into the gap during the New York session when higher-timeframe bias remains bullish. Invalidation is a candle-body close below the gap low.

sources.title: Liquidity Sweep Continuation Lesson
sources.snippet: After sell-side liquidity is swept and price reclaims the level with a bullish body close, look for continuation into an imbalance or fair value gap. Risk is defined beyond the sweep extreme.
